serverInfo.name: tipitakapali-mcp-server
serverInfo.title: Tipitaka Pali Canon & DPD MCP Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server exposing Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi Canon books, chapters, full-text search, and Digital Pāḷi Dictionary (DPD) lookups.

tools.name: pali_dict_lookup
tools.description: Look up Pali words in the Digital Pāḷi Dictionary (DPD) and classical lexicons

word.description: Pāḷi word in Roman script (IAST or Velthuis, e.g. metta or mettā)

dict.description: Dictionary to query (dpd for primary Digital Pali Dictionary, others for PTS/Burmese/Sinhala)

tools.name: pali_canon_search
tools.description: Search the entire 520,000+ paragraph Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi Canon

query.description: Search phrase or term in Pali (e.g. anicca, dukkha, anatta)

tools.name: get_canonical_text
tools.description: Retrieve Pali canon book chapter content by book code and chapter number

tools.name: get_sentences
tools.description: Sentence-level Pāḷi and aligned translations with shared line_id (99.7% match). Use for precise citations [book:cX:pY-LZ].
